snippet.title: Vupechat - Spontaneously collab and meet new VTuber friends!
snippet.description:
Vupechat.com is the #1 social platform for the VTubing community to discover friends with shared interests, play fun mini-games, and instantly collab without the logistics! 

With safety and moderation features like automated NSFW detection, you can enjoy the thrill of spontaneous connections in a safe, fun environment made just for YOU! 

Sign up now for a spot in the Closed Beta ⇢ vupechat.com
